title: tx_queue_stats_get() locking mismatch with documentation
description:
Header line 207 claims 'Thread-safe atomic copy under lock (no longer non-atomic)' but implementation (lines 416-430) does NOT acquire the lock before copying stats. The implementation comment explicitly says 'This read is not atomic with respect to concurrent writes.' Under concurrent push/pop operations, callers could observe torn reads of the stats struct. Either the header documentation is wrong or the code needs locking added.

File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tx_queue.c
Line: 416
close_reason: False positive: tx_queue_stats_get() at lines 420-432 DOES acquire lock (line 428: lock_queue), copy stats (line 429), then release (line 430: unlock_queue). Documentation matches implementation. Bead line reference (416) was in wrong function (tx_queue_empty).
